data.description: Handover October 2025 | Spacious 2-Bedroom in The Hamilton, Town Square
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate LLC presents this well-planned 2-bedroom apartment in The Hamilton, Town Square Dubai. Offering a large layout, modern interiors, and excellent community facilities, this property is ideal for both investors and end-users seeking comfort and long-term value.

Apartment Highlights-

2 Bedrooms with built-in wardrobes
Bright open-plan living and dining area
2 Bathrooms with modern finishes
Balcony with pleasant community views
Off-plan property with handover scheduled for 31 October 2025

Community Features

Swimming pool and fitness center
Landscaped courtyards and parks
On-site retail, cafés, and restaurants
Children’s play areas and splash parks
Cycling and jogging trails
24/7 security and maintenance

Location Advantages

Direct access to Emirates Road
25 minutes to Downtown Dubai
30 minutes to Dubai International Airport
Close to schools, clinics, and supermarkets

This upcoming handover makes it a perfect choice for buyers looking to move in or rent out soon, with excellent potential for both capital appreciation and rental returns.
